turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, Adrian. Rachel speaking. Before we get into your call, I'll complete the identity checks.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Morning, Rachel. My FIN is F three one zero three five seven seven C. Let me get my identity document to check.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Take your time. Are you calling from home today?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I'm at home, sorting out my paperwork before travelling. The document is in my desk drawer.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: No hurry, I'm here. Hopefully you can leave the paperwork behind and enjoy the trip.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Sorry, I've checked my identity document and need to correct the FIN I gave earlier. It is F three one zero three five one seven C. My date of birth is 26 November 1981.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. The identity check is complete. I'm listening.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The holding I want to transact in is Nova Technology Equity Fund. I want to sell part of my existing holding. Please use Japanese yen as the transaction currency for this sale.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: So your aim is to reduce your exposure to the technology sector and free up part of your portfolio for personal spending.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: For background, my current portfolio balance is 10,000,000 Japanese yen. That's the portfolio balance, not the amount for this sale. My earlier investment commitment was 100,000,000 Japanese yen, before the withdrawals. That's historical context, not my current sale instruction. The amount I am specifying for this sale is 5,000,000 in the transaction currency. The quantity for this sale is 100 units. Please place this as a limit order, with a minimum selling price of 50,000 Japanese yen per unit.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Nova Technology Equity Fund is concentrated in technology companies, so a sector-wide drop in valuations or weaker growth expectations can sharply reduce the fund's value. Do you understand how that technology-sector concentration can cause the fund's value to fall sharply?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand. If technology valuations fall across the sector, the fund can drop sharply because its holdings are concentrated there.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction charge for this sale is 40 US dollars, billed separately. The separate billing currency is US dollars; that does not change the currency you've instructed for the sale. You could lose part or even all of the capital invested in this fund, and selling may realise a loss. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including realising a loss on this sale to reduce your concentration?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses and realise a loss to reduce my concentration, provided the sale meets my chosen minimum price.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I recommend reducing your holding in Nova Technology Equity Fund because that lowers your technology-sector concentration and releases funds for personal spending. Setting a minimum sale price also fits your preference, though the sale may not execute.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thank you, Rachel.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: To confirm your final instruction: sell 100 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund, with a specified sale amount of 5,000,000 in Japanese yen, using a limit order at a minimum price of 50,000 Japanese yen per unit. Do you confirm this instruction?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final sale instruction exactly as you have just read it back. Please proceed.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: For routine account updates while you're away, would you prefer a message or a telephone call?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: A message through the banking app, please. I'll check it when I'm back at the hotel.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Noted. Enjoy your trip, Adrian, and thank you for calling.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Rachel. Have a good day. Bye.
